lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. Each column contains 3 to 5 primary nodes, forming a roughly rectangular 2D spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs act as vertices at the intersection of vertical and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately seven commensal fish (remoras) is visible swimming in close proximity beneath the pectoral fin. A non-biological circular watermark containing the text 'Village Dive' is present in the upper right quadrant.
